target_customer: Real estate marketplaces, property managers and brokers (2021 product); homebuyers and renters via real estate partners (current YC description); enterprises with unstructured data (odastudio.ai 2025)
problem: Listing photos are expensive and slow to polish and stage, and buyers struggle to imagine a home furnished; the later site targets turning unstructured data into insights.
business_model: Dashboard for small businesses and API for larger property managers and marketplaces (2021); partner iFrame distribution and product matching (YC page); custom AI pipelines (2025 site)
product_category: AI image enhancement and virtual staging for real estate, later AI home design agent and data pipelines

founders.name: Mert Karakus
founders.background_notes: Named CEO in the December 2021 funding release. The release says all three founders are MIT graduates with AI experience.

founders.name: Ege Ozgirin
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page and in the funding release.

founders.name: Hazal Mine Kansu
founders.background_notes: Named in the December 2021 funding release; not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Computer vision for photo enhancement and staging with generative image models needed solid ML engineering, though built from available vision techniques; later large model work eased it.

defensibility.rationale: Image enhancement and virtual staging could be copied as generative models spread, and several staging services already existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many AI-first virtual staging entrants appeared later and Zillow bought Virtual Staging AI in 2024, per aggregator data; Oda was not acquired.

market_need_then: Real estate listings rely on photos, and the December 2021 release said Oda had processed over 1 million images since a May 2021 launch for marketplaces and property managers.

branding.domain_note: Current site is odastudio.ai (with a ref=yc tag on the YC listing), not an exact oda.com.

identity.logo: Lowercase wordmark odastudio per the company site
identity.visual_style: Minimal wordmark, design credited to Makio Studio on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B claims such as AI Solutions for Complex Data

rebrands.why: Not stated; sources use both names

brand_strength.rationale: Short name, but a similar name (Oda Portal, Oda AI Studio on Product Hunt, Oda the Norwegian grocer) is shared by other products and no source covers the brand itself; aggregators mix entities.

pivots.to: Real estate photo enhancement and virtual staging product launched May 2021

pivots.from: Real estate and home design products
pivots.to: AI solutions for complex data (custom pipelines) per odastudio.ai
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page still describes home design, so the sequence is unclear

outcome_analysis: Oda is active with about 9 people. It launched a real estate photo product in May 2021, raised a 2.8M seed in December 2021 led by Navitas Capital, and no later round was found. Its public positioning shifted across home design, listing photos and enterprise data pipelines, which suggests a search for focus in a market where generative AI lowered barriers and many rivals appeared.
notes: Several aggregators call the company Oda Studio and mix a consumer home design product with a data pipelines business, so identity across sources is uncertain. CB Insights total of 2.95M over 2 rounds and Geometry Venture as seed investor are single aggregator claims, not recorded. The Navitas Medium post returned 403. No competitor source dated near the March 2020 batch was found, so the list is empty. YC page gives founded 2019. Funding release says all three founders are MIT graduates but gives no degrees.
